football_evidence.question: Can North Carolina take away Miami’s big plays?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 0.7 points.
supporting: When North Carolina has the ball (big plays on the ground): North Carolina’s offense turns 5.3% of its runs into explosive gains, and Miami’s defense gives up explosive gains on 3.1% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.5%).
When Miami has the ball (third down): Miami’s offense converts 57.4% of its third downs, and North Carolina’s defense allows opponents to convert 42.8% of their third downs (FBS average 39.5%).

When Miami has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): Miami’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 8.8% of its runs, and North Carolina’s defense stops 8.2% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
When North Carolina has the ball (the run game against the run defense): North Carolina’s offense averages 4.4 yards per carry, and Miami’s defense allows 3.6 yards per carry (FBS average 5.1).
contradicting: EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put North Carolina’s pass defense No. 36 nationally and Miami’s No. 71.

When North Carolina has the ball (the line of scrimmage on running plays): North Carolina’s offense is stopped at or behind the line on 14.8% of its runs, and Miami’s defense stops 14.8% of opponent runs at or behind the line (FBS average 17.4%).
North Carolina comes in on 14 days of rest after an open week; Miami has had 7 days.
quarterbacks: Billy Edwards Jr. has completed 121 of 202 passes (59.9%) for 1,530 yards, 7.6 yards per attempt, 11 touchdowns and 5 interceptions in seven games for North Carolina, and has been sacked on 15 of 217 dropbacks.
Darian Mensah has completed 166 of 205 passes (81.0%) for 2,158 yards, 10.5 yards per attempt, 22 touchdowns and 1 interception in seven games for Miami, and has been sacked on 8 of 213 dropbacks.
Luke Nickel has completed 14 of 19 passes (73.7%) for 193 yards, 10.2 yards per attempt, 3 touchdowns and 1 interception in three games for Miami, and has been sacked on 1 of 20 dropbacks.
